item.title: Outgoing PM Dick Schoof reflects after final Cabinet meeting; Collapse was inevitable
item.description: After his final Cabinet meeting, outgoing Prime Minister Dick Schoof acknowledged that he had long expected his government would not complete its full term.

item.title: Tesla to launch advanced self-driving system in the Netherlands, pending approval
item.description: Tesla plans to introduce its advanced Full Self-Driving (Supervised) system in the Netherlands in the near future.

item.title: Enigmatic musician Irène Schrader talks imposter syndrome, modeling, and global roots
item.description: From her childhood playing classical piano in China to her emergence as a multilingual pop talent, Irène Schrader has used music to bridge the various cultures she calls her own.

item.title: Hundreds of passengers on Utrecht train that jumps track; Evacuation underway
item.description: A train operated by national railway NS skipped over a loose track just south of Utrecht, at a the same spot where overhead electricity lines were also broken.

item.title: Netherlands still lacks permits for pesticides a year after Council of State ruling
item.description: Dutch provinces have not issued a single permit for pesticides that could harm protected nature, nearly a year after the Council of State ruled such licenses are required.

item.title: Home batteries can cut energy bills, but payback may take decades
item.description: Homeowners in the Netherlands can lower their energy bills by adding home batteries, but it is still unclear how long it takes to recover the investment, the Dutch homeowners’ association Verenigin

item.title: Churches from different cultures struggling to find space in the Netherlands
item.description: Christian churches that have come to the Netherlands from a different culture are struggling to find housing in the country.

item.title: Volendam stun PSV with late winner to hand leaders second defeat of the season
item.description: PSV suffered their second defeat of the season in the Eredivisie on Friday. The league leaders lost 2-1 away to struggling FC Volendam.

item.title: Record 32,000 anonymous tips help police catch suspects in 2025
item.description: Meld Misdaad Anoniem saw a record number of anonymous tips in 2025.

item.title: Dutch florists fee slower Valentine’s orders amid Carnival and holidays
item.description: Carnival appears to be cutting into Valentine’s Day rose sales in the Netherlands this year.
